title: Australian Meat Pie
description: A classic German-inspired meat pie filled with a hearty mixture of ground meat and vegetables, topped with a flaky crust.
instructions: Roll out the flatbread to fit a 9-inch pie dish.
In a pan over medium-high heat, cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Add the ketchup and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Pour the meat mixture into the pie crust and spread evenly.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
